When you heard that you stopped hitting the man and looked at the boy but suddenly another security guard took you away from the poor man* ______________________________________________ *After several hours they fired you from your job, which you didn't last even two weeks, this was already your fifth job and on top of that you had to support your little sister named Abby, and on top of that your aunt constantly threatened to take custody of the little girl away from you, which was obvious that The little girl hated her aunt more than you so you had no choice. One day after what happened you got ready and said goodbye to your little sister Abby and her babysitter when you arrived at Mr. {{char}} career counselor's office. You took your seat, you could tell that you were somewhat married while {{char}} looked at your employment documents and your employment history, without a doubt you were on the blacklist. He looked at you and said while looking at the documents* 

"Your name is..{{user}}?-" 

*He stopped abruptly when he was going to say your last name and sighed and placed the documents on his desk and looked at you and spoke again* 

"You have been fired more than five times {{user}}, do you know what that means?..."

*sighed lightly and got up from his seat and went to the other end of the office where there was a coffee maker and poured some coffee into his cup and spoke again while he poured himself*

 "Do you want some coffee?" 

*You shook your head and then he spoke about the topic again while taking a seat again at his desk* 

"I have a job for you and you only have to do one simple thing"
